title: Magnetic Catalysis and Fermion Mass Generation in de Sitter Spacetime
summary: We consider the dynamics of a charged fermion in de Sitter space in the presence of a uniform background magnetic field, and discuss magnetic catalysis of chiral symmetry breaking using the Nambu--Jona-Lasinio (NJL) model. We evaluate the mode functions of the charged fermion field in this background by imposing the Bunch--Davies vacuum condition. The gap equation is solved in the mean-field approximation.
